items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, who did you have in your own violin? I know I mentioned Rankin Dixon. Did you tell me who you used in your own violin? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I had Herman Sherman.

ctx.x: Now, who did you have in your own violin? I know I mentioned Rankin Dixon. Did you tell me who you used in your own violin?
Well, I had Herman Sherman. All right. My two sons. I would use a violin. And I would use a violin. On his violin. And that dial. Mm-hmm.
